title: Paragraph method
subtitle: Map clauses before consulting a translation.
overview: A reliable first pass is structural: mark finite verbs, clause openers, participles, and prepositional phrases before looking up vocabulary.
A paragraph map preserves ambiguity where the Greek is still unclear; it is better than guessing a polished English sentence too early.

items.en: Main verbs: saw, believed; ἐλθών supplies the accompanying arrival.

items.grc: ὅτι ὁ θεὸς φῶς ἐστιν καὶ σκοτία οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῷ οὐδεμία.
items.en: Two coordinated claims introduced by ὅτι.
